<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="כסלו_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518915689_theRebbe_467" batchId="meluket-_D7_9B_D7_A1_D7_9C_D7_95_meluket__BH_POST_1766518915689_theRebbe_467__p003">
  <section v="6">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This explains the division of the three matters into two categories, with Torah and Gemilus Chasadim preceding prayer.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And according to this, it will be understood why it divides these three matters into two categories, and why it places Torah and Gemilus Chasadim before prayer,</t>
    <t s="1">for first it speaks about the intention and the intended purpose,</t>
    <t s="2">which is the drawing down that comes through Torah and Gemilus Chasadim,</t>
    <t s="3">and afterwards—about the preparation for this,</t>
    <t s="4">which is the elevation of prayer.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="7">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Within Torah and Gemilus Chasadim themselves, Torah is placed first despite Gemilus Chasadim achieving a greater dwelling below, as explained in Tanya.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And within Torah and Gemilus Chasadim themselves, it places Torah before Gemilus Chasadim,</t>
    <t s="1">even though the dwelling in the lower realms is accomplished more through Gemilus Chasadim than through Torah</t>
    <t s="2">(as explained in Tanya,</t>
    <t s="3">regarding the superiority of charity)</t>
    <t s="4">—in addition to the fact that this is their order during the day, from the study hall to one's business affairs, etc., as mentioned above,</t>
    <t s="5">nevertheless, within Torah and Gemilus Chasadim themselves,</t>
    <t s="6">our Sages, of blessed memory, said,</t>
    <t s="7">"Torah study is equivalent to all of them."</t>
    <t s="8">And even though it is explained in Igeres HaKodesh</t>
    <t s="9">that now the primary service is through charity,</t>
    <t s="10">this is specifically now,</t>
    <t s="11">in the footsteps of Moshiach, when the Sukkah of Dovid has fallen to the level of feet and heels, which is the level of Asiyah,</t>
    <t s="12">but in the days of our Sages,</t>
    <t s="13">(who said "whoever engages, etc.")</t>
    <t s="14">the primary service was Torah study,</t>
    <t s="15">as explained in Igeres HaKodesh there.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="8">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>The order of Torah, Gemilus Chasadim, and prayer is from higher to lower according to their importance.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And based on all this, the order of these three matters will be understood: Torah,</t>
    <t s="1">Gemilus Chasadim, and prayer</t>
    <t s="2">(in public),</t>
    <t s="3">for this order is from higher to lower,</t>
    <t s="4">according to the importance of the matters: Torah,</t>
    <t s="5">which</t>
    <t s="6">(in their days)</t>
    <t s="7">is the primary virtue,</t>
    <t s="8">then Gemilus Chasadim,</t>
    <t s="9">which is lower than Torah as mentioned above,</t>
    <t s="10">and then prayer,</t>
    <t s="11">which is preparation for the drawing down of Torah and Gemilus Chasadim.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
